text: If you need a doctor in Krabi I highly recommend not wasting your time going anywhere else. An excellent doctor who explained everything and knew exactly what the issue was. I noticed a lot of other clinics had reviews which was clearly written by AI / bots which is why I chose to come here and I’m so relieved I did.  Also didn’t get ripped off like we did with a clinic elsewhere. Thank you Dr!
I came here for a blocked ear and it got sorted straight away. The doctor was super friendly, as were the staff. 10/10
Had my blocked ear flushed out here. Really friendly doctor and gave free ear drops. Cost 1700. Would recommend

Diagnosed asthma attack immediately, wasnt even in waiting room 5minutes, seen to immediately, and explained to me exactly whats going on and why, best doctor ive seen in the 4years ive been here, will be my regular now,...speeks perfect english too polite friendly and extrenely helpful, got all meds i needed, and left feeling happier than when i went in, ..highly recommend, nurses are good to talk too as well, friendly efficient and professional...great service here

This man…THIS MAN!!! He is uncle.❤️ Honestly the smoothest, bestest and affordable experience. I am not surprised of his 5/5 rating I mean the second I got in I hot attended very well. It was fast and smooth through reception. Dr Samboon himself is lovely and explained everything clearly. I had wax/water in my ear and he relieved it effectively. I went in nervous but his professionalism kept me calm and he even let my friend be in the room with me. And out of all the places in the area I found his price to be the best and very reasonable for what I had done. Overall great experience would 100% recommend.

Professional care, we went there with our two children because of some ear infection from pool or sea. Paid 700 bath per child incl. tablets... All explained in perfect English.
24h later the medicine works. Thx.
Had my blocked ears cleared out here. Doctor was very nice and spoke good English. He also explained everything very well. They were busy and I still got in in a good time. Thank you

A friend who lives in Ao Nang recommended this clinic.

The service is fantastic. Doctor is definitely a first class professional.

Me and my girlfriend arrived with severe food poisoning. After a wait of around 20 min we entered the doctor's office.

1. His English is fluent
2. His explanation is clear and simple. Explained very clearly what we should do and what we should avoid
3. Prescribed us with the treatment, and in 2 hours we felt already 90% better.

Also, separate comment for the staff - very lovely and kind ladies working there. They prepared all sets of documents for us to claim with the insurance.

We're very satisfied with the treatment.

Total cost: 7100 Baht each

I recently visited a local clinic in Ao Nang, Krabi, to get an earwax blockage removed, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the experience. The doctor was incredibly kind, making me feel comfortable right away. Unlike other clinics, they offered the best rates by far and didn’t charge tourist prices, which I really appreciated.

The whole procedure took less than 10 minutes. The doctor used a gentle vacuum suction method to clear the blockage in my ear, and the process was quick and painless. I was in and out in no time, with my ear feeling completely clear and comfortable.

This clinic is a fantastic option for any tourist. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality care and fair pricing in Ao Nang!

Excellent clinic. My boyfriend had developed some sort of rash and we walked in and were seen in 20 minutes. The staff and Dr. spoke English very well and were incredibly polite, helpful and professional. We read the reviews beforehand and they were as expected, exceptional service and very affordable compared to some other clinics we've been to in Thailand. The Dr. really took his time to explain what was happening and printed out some information for us to take with us, we didn't feel rushed at all. Highly recommend this clinic!

Went today with ear issues after a dive. Clinic was recommended by a local, and locals attended while I was there - good signs. Very friendly, helpful and efficient staff. Low cost. Highly recommend if you need to see a doctor 👍 …

Yesterday, I visited Dr. Somboon Clinic, at the advice of a friend. I got there shortly after opening and was attended to almost immediately, by the staff. After giving them all my information, I sat down and waited for about 5 minutes. I was taken to see the doctor, and he asked me about my concerns and my medical history. He physically tested my  leg, to see what the problem was. He prescribed a few meds for me, and I was on my way out. Very professional and knowledgeable. The problem I was having was some  pretty serious pain in my leg. I thought it was my cancer spreading, but the medication he prescribed for me, seems to work. I feel better today, and I just started on the medication yesterday. I highly recommend Dr. Somboon Polyclinic. I am very satisfied how I was treated.

My son had stomac problems 3 days in a row. We went to dr Somboon. Almost no waiting time, a very clear and pedagogic doctor. Very good english. We were on our way to the hotel within half an hour, with all medicine needed. He was feeling much better the day after.
No high costs, very good service.

Checked my wound for infection and Dr. Pruittipong was super helpful and very humble. Even demonstrated the skin tissue on a paper for me to understand. On top of that he gave me free cream and medicine which I'm super thankful for. Highly recommend!

This is the best place to go if you’re having a medical issue. All the staff was kind, efficient, and spoke perfect English. It’s clear they actually want to help you, not just take your money. I saw the doctor, got a dengue and flu test, and got antibiotics all for €60. There will be a queue leading up to opening at 4pm, so I highly recommend getting there 20 minutes early so you can be within the first 5 people. I was the third person seen and it took 1.5 hours total, and they were incredibly busy. The hours of operation on google are accurate. They gave me all necessary insurance papers in English.

I went to the hospital with pain in my ear. At the reception desk they took all my information and literally within a couple of minutes I was already at the doctor’s office. The doctor diagnosed otitis externa and prescribed all the necessary medications. A few days have passed and I am almost well. The hospital itself is very clean and comfortable, all the staff are very kind and welcoming. The cost was very low. I highly recommend this hospital. Thank you Dr. Samboon and all the staff ❤️

I received an excellent service here. I arrived without an appointment and was seen very quickly. The staff were wonderful and spoke English well. The doctor and nurses were kind, compassionate and explained everything to me in a way in which I new exactly what the treatment was. I couldn't recommend them highly enough if you need medical treatment in Ao Nang.
Warm friendly doctor, spoke good English and treated us well. Bit of a wait but well worth it
Dr. Pruitipong is very friendly and experience. He speaks good english as well. Greatly recommended if you got any injuries in ao nang!
Excellent doctor. Got a few stitches from him. He made sure i was fine and gave me medicines and a certificate for my flight. Definitely visit him if you need any medical help.

My partner went here after sustaining a rope burn while climbing. We were seen very quickly (less than 30 minutes wait). The nurse cleaned the wound, removing dead skin, and rebandaged it very tidily. The doctor gave us good advice on how to speed up the healing process and avoid scar tissue formation, as well as prescribed antibiotics in case of infection. All staff were friendly and spoke good English. Overall cost was 1400 baht.

Very quick and quality service, did blood test, results, diagnose and treatment in less than half an hour, when I got infection while acclimatization to a different climate and time zone. Good English, very nice and helpful professionals. Not a "here's your pill, now get lost" kinda service for tourists that I was mentally prepared for.

We took my elementary school age kid to see Dr. Somboon based on reviews, but more importantly, after asking a couple hotel staff where they go for their clinic needs. The wait was an hour long at 5pm on a weekday. The front office staff was warm and caring. Dr. Somboon was also warm and caring. He was open to hearing my concerns and thoughts on my son’s sickness (severe skin rashes). I was open to his diagnosis and his reassurance that while it looks bad, it will be ok. He gave us some new medication the supplement what a pharmacist had diagnosed and given us earlier. My son’s rash improved drastically within a day. I cannot highly recommend enough. Thank you Dr. Somboon!

Note: the hours seem weird, but are correct. They are only open for a few hours in the afternoon.

My son had a painful ear infection after swimming. The doctor did an excellent job explaining to him the parts of his ears, what was happening, and why it was painful. He set my son and me both at ease. The next morning my son said, "You …

The girlfriend had severe food poisoning. We came in sometime in the evening, saw the doctor super quick, he was ultra nice and knowledgeable. Very funny and high spirited. Spoke fast but good English. He got us some meds and checked us out. Whole thing was about 45 minutes and cost around 65USD for visit and meds.
We got ahold of a nurse friend at home and had everything verified by a US doctor so Somboon knows what's up. She is already feeling better!
Had blocked ears cleaned out was fast and professional service for chap price to would recommend

Nobody wants to go to the doctor while traveling, staff spoke English well and were able to help me quickly.  I needed a minor surgery due to an infection.  Was in and out and given proper care for an affordable price as obviously my insurance isn't going to be accepted most anywhere.  3000baht for the procedure and dressing.  Would recommend to travelers in need.

Great doctor. Diagnosed our 1 year old and gave us the meds to treat her. Very very friendly, understanding and empathic. The nurses are also very helpful and kind. English level is great.
Thank you so much.

We have been to Dr. Somboon's polyclinic on January 31st, 2023, as my ankle got twisted very badly and was swollen up so much. The wait time to see the doctor was very short. He was very friendly and described the injury in detail with drawings and pictures. He is very professional and knowledgeable, and he took his time explaining everything to us about the injury. Charges are also reasonable. My recovery went exactly as he described. I am glad that I went to his clinic.

I would recommend visiting Dr. Somboon's polyclinic if you need to see a doctor while you are in Ao-Nang.

Go there if you need medical help! They are so kind, helpful and professional. I went there for a terrible painful virus to the nerve and the doctor calmed me down a lot and give me the good explanation of what to expect the coming days/weeks. He give me the right medicine that ease the pain. He is so kind and understanding and took all the time for the consultation. Highly recommend this place!

We went to see the doctor as our daughter came out in a rash along with wheezing due to the humidity. The doctor was great, spoke good English and was very attentive. We went pretty early and was seen within the first 10 minutes, but when we came out the clinic was packed.

Came here together with my boyfriend with problem - food poisoning. The nurses listened and asked for symptoms we had, measured our body temperature and etc. The doctor is really good person by giving advices what to eat, drink and how to take medications. He also have good humour! Nurses and the doctor talks very good in English. The biggest recommendation!

I went there for swollen ankle and slight pain in the calf.
They said they do not work with my Canadian insurer - Manulife, but the consultation was 700 baht (23 USD) so I would have paid it myself. …

Our 4 yr. old fell ill at the end of our trip with a high fever. The resort where we stayed highly recommended Dr. Somboon and we are glad they did. His staff is very kind and professional. The clinic is very clean and appears to be well organized. Dr. Somboon is very kind, knowledgeable, and helpful. Hopefully you don't need a doctor during your holiday but if you do, Dr. Somboon is the one to visit.

We had similar experience as the other reviews tell. We did not have to wait long, Dr. Somboon speaks good english, he was very nice, and the visit was 700 baht. Prices are also shown on a table at the reception.

Great experience with doctor here. Had ear issues after scuba diving. Took his time to explain the exact problem I was having and then proceeded to tell me all the medication I would need. He also wrote down what anti biotics I could need in a weeks time if it didn't clear up.

Consultation was 700 bhat.. He supplied all the medication I needed and that was an extra 600 bhat.

Very positive experience.

We came here because of stomach pain. The staff in the Front Office were super friendly and good english speaking. Even without an appointment, we only had to wait a few minutes.
Dr. Somboon is very kind and competent. He explains your symptoms in very good english. He did not only prescribe meds, but explained how they work as we had a few concerns before.
Highly recommended!

Very good doctor, quality care. Bit small premises so was very crowded with sick people as we were waiting for our turn. They co-operate with SOS International so direct debiting with certain insurance companies works nicely. Be sure to contact SOS BEFORE you go to the doctor so it will be a faster experience for you.

Very professional, clean, and reasonable on pricing. Went in to treat an infected bug bite. The doctor explained his diagnosis, provided literature to give a deeper explanation, and wrote my perspiration, and provided documentation for insurance claims all in 10 mins. Very grateful for them!

Treated me with multiple IV bags, etc within minutes of entering the clinic due to food poisoning & severe dehydration. Within 24 hours I was back on my feet resuming my vacation. Great guy, clean facility, and attentive staff. This is the kind of doctor you only hope for in the States, and at a fraction of the cost.

I hurt my foot while in Ao Nang, I couldn't walk on it.

Before going to the doctor, I was a concerned it would require costly x-rays to …

I had an eye infection while vacationing in Aonang. Conjunctivitis of the eye to be exact. I went here after reading positive reviews. Fast, friendly and spoke English. Clearly communicated what it was and prescribed medication.
Entire thing took less than 10 minutes. Clean clinic.  Professional service. Answered all my questions and addressed all my concerns.
Whole thing cost around $50 USD and they dispensed all meds and antibiotics there which was included in the price.
Infection was gone in 24 hours. Thank god.

Apparently, there are other places which charge foreigners a lot more. So this place was a much better option.

text: Great service. I came with an injury on my foot and the doctor explained clearly what I need to do and how long it will take to heal. …

I went to a lot of doctors in past 6 mounts and there is no clinic explain me in detail what check I need to do and Whats going on. This doctor tell me everything: what I need to do, what medicine take, what to do to prevent more complications. The best service in Ao Nang. Doctor speak also very good English and not give me bunch of medicine, not make business on me just helps me and I’m appreciated.

Very pleased with service - recommend this clinic for all medical needs. The doctor, nurse and front desk staff were all very helpful, informative and friendly while we were travelling from Australia.

PERFECT

After being ripped off at another medical practice, we found Dr Samboon. …

Highly skilled Doctor. Speaks fluent English. Very friendly and helpful. Had a minor surgery. It was quick, and painless. Doctor Somboon helped me feel very relaxed during the procedure with his clear communication. So thankful I went to see him.

Best clinic & doctor in Krabi!👍👍👍
My partner broke her nail while river rafting & after reading some of the reviews of all the clinics we went to Dr. Somboon. Others will ask you for your insurance provider & rip you off but here the staff really cares & gives you the advise & treatment you need. The staff is really friendly & the doctor was really nice to explain us all the details. All up consultation & bandage cost us 200 BHAT which would have cost us at least 1200 to 1500 BHAT else where. ⭐️💫

Came at 7:30pm because I had a few concerning symptoms. The dr was very knowledgeable and informative, asked the right questions, explained his diagnosis thoroughly, spoke English very well and reasonable price which can be claimed back on travel insurance. Definitely recommend.
very welcoming staff and cheerful doctor - explained perfectly in english.
